Plug-in Predictive Distribution

Source: R/predict_objects.R
pred_plugin.Rd

The family at the estimates, averaged only over the effects that random sets aside. The interval is the estimative one, which ignores the error in the estimates and so covers less than the level in a small sample. It costs one evaluation of the predictors and is the cheapest of the three predictive objects.

Usage

pred_plugin()

Value

An S7 object of class PredPlugin, inheriting from predictive_type(), with the one property label.

Details

See predictive_distributions.

See also

pred_averaged(), pred_bootstrap(), prediction_interval(), predictive_distributions.

Examples

set.seed(1)
dd <- data.frame(x = runif(40))
dd$y <- 1 + dd$x + rnorm(40, sd = 0.4)
fit <- statmod(y ~ x, distributions7::gaussian1_distrib(), dd)
predict(fit, what = "response", newdata = data.frame(x = 0.5),
        interval = prediction_interval(predictive = pred_plugin()))
#>        fit        se     lower    upper
#> 1 1.529108 0.3337831 0.8749056 2.183311
